Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA / TERM & CONDITION 1. Service provider must cover all safety compliances with relation to passenger safety. 2. Service provider must submit valid license for safety of lift. 3. Bidder must upload signed and stamped BOQ compliances and ATC document. 4. Bidder should not have been suspended on GeM during the last three years. 5. Bidder must be registered in the state; evidentiary proof must be submitted along with the bid. 6. Data sheet of product specification must be attached with the bid as per bid specifications. 7. Undertaking for non-blacklisting of firm on ₹100/- stamp paper, duly notarized and stamped with the bid number. 8. Bidder should have a valid ISO 9001:2015 Certificate. 9. Bidder must have work experience of at least the last two years. 10. Undertaking for solvency and financial standing of firm on ₹100/- stamp paper, duly notarized and sta mped with the bid number. 11. Bidder must submit last three years' ITR copies along with audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss stat ement. 12. Verified turnover certificate (certified by CA with UDIN) must be attached. 13. Anti-Collusion Certificate during the bid period must be submitted on company letterhead. 14. Bidder must have an average turnover of at least ₹20 Lakh in the last three years. 15. Bidder must attach a copy of valid MSME / Udyam Registration. 16. Bidder must submit a copy of PAN Card and valid GST Registration Certificate. 17. All submitted documents must be duly stamped and signed by the bidder; incomplete documents will lead to the rejection of the bid. .
